# Picsel

> Picsel is a web design and automation studio in Cornwall, building websites and doing search work for local trades and small businesses.

Contact: Ben Miller, 07456 809049, benwmiller101@gmail.com
Area served: Cornwall

Picsel is a new studio. It has built 5 live sites, all listed below, and
makes no claims about client numbers, years in business or awards, because it has
none to make. Anything stated here can be checked against the live sites.

## What the studio does

- Websites for local trades and small businesses
- Search work, both Google and AI assistants
- Google Business Profile setup and upkeep
- Custom automation tools for repetitive office work
- One client per trade, per town

## Work

- [A Nevitt Construction](https://picsel.example/work/nevitt-construction/): Construction in Hayle, Cornwall. Live site: https://haylebuilders.com/
- [Lanora House](https://picsel.example/work/lanora-house/): House clearance in Hayle, Cornwall. Live site: https://www.lanorahouse.com/
- [AJC Removals & Clearances](https://picsel.example/work/ajc-removals/): Removals & clearance in Cornwall. Live site: https://ajcremovals.co.uk/
- [Julie Miller Art](https://picsel.example/work/julie-miller-art/): Artist portfolio in Scottish Borders. Live site: https://juliemillerart.co.uk/
- [House of Cornwall](https://picsel.example/work/house-of-cornwall/): Antiques & auctions in Hayle, Cornwall. Live site: https://houseofcornwall.live/

- [A Nevitt Construction | Picsel](https://picsel.example/work/nevitt-construction/): A site for a family-run building contractor in Hayle, covering everything from single-storey extensions to full design-and-build new homes.
- [Lanora House | Picsel](https://picsel.example/work/lanora-house/): A licensed house clearance and cleaning firm working across Cornwall and the South West. Built by Picsel.
- [AJC Removals & Clearances | Picsel](https://picsel.example/work/ajc-removals/): A removals and clearance company covering Cornwall, Devon and beyond. Built by Picsel.
- [Julie Miller Art | Picsel](https://picsel.example/work/julie-miller-art/): A portfolio for an illustrator working in mixed media in the Scottish Borders, where the landscape drives the work. Built by Picsel.
- [House of Cornwall | Picsel](https://picsel.example/work/house-of-cornwall/): Live clearance auctions broadcast from Hayle every week, selling antiques, retro pieces and curiosities that come out of real house clearances.
